etymology: Phono-semantic: boat (舟) + 玄 (phonetic ゲン) — the ship's side: gunwale.
mnemonic: The rail you grip in weather — ゲン. 右舷: starboard.

etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 殳 (phonetic コ) — the leg's fork: thigh.
mnemonic: Where the legs disagree — また. 大股: the long stride.

etymology: Pictograph: the bent figure asking — to beg, request (乞う).
mnemonic: Bowed with palms out — こう. ご期待乞う: 'anticipation begged' — stay tuned.

etymology: Pictograph: the hooked curve — bent: hook; detention's hook (勾留).
mnemonic: The comma-shaped jewel — コウ. 勾玉: the magatama of shrines.

etymology: Phono-semantic: mouth (口) + 侯 (phonetic コウ) — the voice's corridor: throat.
mnemonic: The hall behind the mouth — のど. 喉が渇く: the corridor asking for water.

etymology: Phono-semantic: wood (木) + 更 (phonetic コウ) — the stiff stalk: blockage (梗塞); the outline (梗概).
mnemonic: The branch stuck in the pipe — コウ. 心筋梗塞: the blockage that makes headlines.

etymology: Compound: the head tilted — an inclined moment: about, around (that time).
mnemonic: Time measured by a tilted head — ころ. 子供の頃: 'back around childhood'.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 疒 + 艮 (phonetic コン) — the mark that stays: scar.
mnemonic: The wound's stubborn signature — あと. 痕跡: the forensic trace.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 坐 (phonetic ザ) — bent under force: to sprain; spirit sprained: setback (挫折).
mnemonic: The ankle and the ambition, twisted — ザ. 挫折: the comeback's prologue.

etymology: Compound: the pass filled with earthworks — to block; the fort that does it (要塞).
mnemonic: The corridor bricked shut — ふさぐ. 要塞: the fortress; 塞がる: schedules too.

etymology: Compound: timber bound like book-slips (冊) — the palisade: fence.
mnemonic: Logs lined like a shelf of books — サク. 柵: the zoo's polite boundary.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + a phonetic (サツ) — pressing near; alive only in 挨拶.
mnemonic: 挨's other half — サツ. 挨拶: the pair that only works together.

etymology: Compound: the axe (斤) at the execution cart (車) — to cut down: slay; strikingly fresh (斬新).
mnemonic: The period drama's sound effect — きる. 斬新: an idea that cuts.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 女 + 疾 (phonetic シツ) — the burning envy: jealousy.
mnemonic: Envy at fever speed — シッ. 嫉妬: the green pair.

etymology: Phono-semantic: flesh (月) + 重 (phonetic シュ) — flesh grown heavy: swelling.
mnemonic: The lump that outweighs its neighbors — はれる. 腫瘍: the clinical term.

etymology: Compound: the incanting mouth (口+兄, the speaker) — the spoken spell: curse.
mnemonic: Words with malice compiled in — のろう. 呪い: J-horror's other engine.

etymology: Phono-semantic: foot (足) + 就 (phonetic シュウ) — the driving foot: to kick; to reject (蹴る).
mnemonic: The foot's veto — ける. 蹴る: balls and proposals.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 式 (phonetic ショク) — cleaned by hand: to wipe.
mnemonic: The cloth pass over the counter — ふく. 拭う: tears too.

etymology: Phono-semantic: body (尸) + 九 (phonetic キュウ→しり) — the rear: buttocks, tail end.
mnemonic: The body's caboose — しり. 尻込み: backing out, literally.

etymology: Phono-semantic: plant (艹) + 心 'heart' (phonetic シン) — the plant's heart: core, wick, pencil lead.
mnemonic: The heart of the candle and the pencil — シン. 芯が強い: strong-cored.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 臤 (phonetic ジン) + flesh (月) — the paired filter organs: kidneys.
mnemonic: The body's loyal retainers, filtering — ジン. 腎臓: the kidney, on the chart.

etymology: Phono-semantic: garment (衤) + 居 (phonetic キョ→すそ) — where the robe settles: hem; the mountain's hem (裾野).
mnemonic: The garment's ground floor — すそ. 富士の裾野: Fuji's trailing hem.

etymology: Phono-semantic: ice (冫) + 妻 (phonetic セイ) — chilling: dreadful; awe flipped positive: amazing (すごい).
mnemonic: The shiver that became a compliment — すごい. 凄い: modern Japanese's busiest adjective.

etymology: Phono-semantic: jar (酉) + 星 (phonetic セイ) — sobered from the jar: to wake, be disillusioned (覚醒).
mnemonic: Stars fading, head clearing — セイ. 覚醒: full wakefulness — heroes and villains both claim it.

etymology: Originally a ceremonial axe; borrowed for kin: relatives (親戚).
mnemonic: The clan that shows up armed with advice — セキ. 親戚: the New Year's table.

etymology: Pictograph: the ribs meeting the backbone over flesh (月) — the spine.
mnemonic: The body's tent-pole — セキ. 脊椎: the vertebral column.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 前 (phonetic セン) + fire (灬) — heated before serving: to roast, decoct.
mnemonic: Fire under the 'before' — せんべい's first kanji. 煎茶: tea, properly brewed.

etymology: Compound: drooling (次) over the sheep (羊) — wanting what's theirs: envy.
mnemonic: Eyeing the neighbor's lamb dinner — うらやましい. 羨ましい: said fifty times a day.

etymology: A kokuji — coined by Edo-era anatomists: flesh (月) + spring (泉) — the body's springs: glands.
mnemonic: The flesh's fountains — セン. 涙腺: the tear gland — 'weak 涙腺' means you cry at commercials.

etymology: Phono-semantic: words (言) + 全 (phonetic セン) — reasoned through fully: to examine; the point of it (詮).
mnemonic: Talked through to the bottom — セン. 詮索: prying — examination without invitation.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 月 + 善 (phonetic ゼン) — the meal served on its stand: tray; the counter for servings.
mnemonic: Dinner on its own little stage — ゼン. お膳: the ryokan's presentation.

etymology: Pictograph: the layered steamer pot — generational layers: great-grand (曽祖父); once before (かつて).
mnemonic: One more layer back in time — ソ. 曽祖父: the great-grandfather stratum.

etymology: Phono-semantic: beast (犭) + 且 (phonetic ソ) — the stalking eye: to aim.
mnemonic: The crosshair with patience — ねらう. 狙い: the plan's exact center.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 朔 (phonetic ソ) — against the current: to retrace, go back to.
mnemonic: Salmon-style through the timeline — さかのぼる. 遡る: history and bank statements.

etymology: Phono-semantic: 疒 + 叟 (phonetic ソウ) — wasted lean: to grow thin.
mnemonic: The waistline in retreat — やせる. 痩せる: January's verb.

etymology: Phono-semantic: hand (扌) + 足 (phonetic ソク) — seized mid-stride: to capture, apprehend (meaning too).
mnemonic: Hand closing on the running idea — とらえる. 捉え方: how you grip a concept.

etymology: Phono-semantic: garment (衤) + 由 (phonetic ユウ→そで) — the arm's passage: sleeve.
mnemonic: The garment's corridors — そで. 袖振り合うも他生の縁: even sleeves brushing is fate.

etymology: Phono-semantic: movement (辶) + 孫 (phonetic ソン) — stepping back like the junior generation: modest.
mnemonic: Giving way as the grandchild would — ソン. 謙遜: humility, performed properly.

etymology: Compound: what droops (垂) from the mouth (口) — saliva.
mnemonic: The mouth's overflow valve — つば. 固唾を呑む: swallowing hard at the climax.

etymology: Phono-semantic: earth (土) + 隹 (phonetic タイ) — heaped up: piled (堆積).
mnemonic: The sediment doing its slow paperwork — タイ. 堆積: geology's inbox.
